# Oryx Institute

> Oryx Polytechnic Institute, also trading as Oryx Institute, Close Corporation CC/2026/12517, is a prelaunch polytechnic-style institute and consulting practice for Namibia. Its public work is research, current practice and ventures. The approved public mailbox is info@oryxinstitute.org.

## Institutional status

Oryx is working toward NTA training-provider registration. It is not registered with the Namibia Training Authority and it is not accredited by the Namibia Qualifications Authority. It does not offer accredited qualifications, NQF credits, accredited programmes or a public campus. A future qualification, intake, fee or start date will be published only after formal confirmation.

- [Institutional Status](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/status): the factual NTA-registration and NQA-accreditation disclosure, with official regulator links.
- [The Register](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/register): dated public institutional updates.

## Current work

- [Owner's Desk](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/practice#owners-desk): business counselling for Namibian owners. Scope and fees are confirmed in writing for each enquiry.
- [Market R&D](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/practice#market-rd): feasibility, market sizing, competitor reads and route-to-market work, gathered on Namibian ground and written to be used.
- [Practice](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/practice): the current commercial practice and its status disclosure.
- [Enquire](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/apply): one public office for questions about current work or future learning pathways.

## Recruitment

- [Careers](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/careers): 9 current Oryx recruitment pages for Ongwediva. Each Lead Instructor listing is one senior programme position across its grouped level, strand and short-course scope, with a closing time and an email-first application form.
- Applications close at 23:59 CAT (UTC+2) on 27 November 2026. Applications go to vacancies@oryxinstitute.org.
- The site stores no application-form data. The form prepares an email in the applicant's own mail client; applicants must review it, attach a CV and send it themselves.
- Role-specific minimum qualifications, licences and years of experience have not been published. Applicants should submit relevant experience and a CV; Oryx may request role-relevant evidence from shortlisted candidates.
- The Lead Instructor specialisms describe intended work scope only. They do not announce courses, accredited qualifications, NQF credits, enrolment or a public campus.

## Research

- [Research](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/research): market research engagements and institutional Research Notes. Published notes are English-first and have an error-reporting contact route.

## Ventures and relationships

- [Ventures](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/ventures): Oryx uses operating companies to understand sectors through real service and real customers.
- [Corner Spa](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/corner-spa): the first operating venture, active in Windhoek with Mendozer Investments. Booking and service details stay on the spa's own site.
- [Untag Guesthouse planned campus site](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Uvvtp4Ymcv6Vbr1G7?g_st=ic): Oryx identifies Untag Guesthouse as a planned future hospitality-focused site. The site is not open and does not currently offer courses, enrolment, qualifications or accredited programmes. Hospitality, tour guiding, safety and administration are possible future areas only.
- [Tangison Technologies](https://tangison.com): identity, technology and learning-platform services under agreement. Tangison Technologies and Oryx Institute use the shared public telephone number +264 83 676 4338. This is not accreditation or regulatory endorsement.
- Ongwediva and Karibib are future initiatives. Neither is an open campus or confirmed operating venture.

## Markdown mirrors

Current public pages have an English-first markdown shelf at `/md/<path>`: [the index](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/md), [/md/about](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/md/about), [/md/status](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/md/status), [/md/research](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/md/research), [/md/practice](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/md/practice), [/md/apply](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/md/apply), [/md/careers](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/md/careers) and [/md/links](https://www.oryxinstitute.org/md/links). Every published career role has the same markdown alternate below `/md/careers/`. Markdown is an explicit typed alternate; ordinary page requests remain canonical HTML.
